subject: hermes: L4 Bayesian spine live - market prior x ingested signals = posterior with shown math
body: The reasoning engine now runs the two-layer doctrine in code. intelligence/reasoning/signals.py: typed Signal records (10 domains, mandatory provenance, likelihood ratios with MEASURED/COMPUTED/REPORTED labels, effective_lr for contradict-direction). intelligence/reasoning/bayes.py: MarketPrior from real prices + update() = prior_odds x prod(LR), every step recorded, neutral/LR=1 signals logged as unapplied, never dropped. run_game.ranked_board now carries bayes_updates when priors+signals are supplied. PROVEN ON TODAY'S REAL INGESTS: Kalshi DAL@PHI yes_ask 0.51 (Layer 1) x air-density carry LR 1.10 from the Open-Meteo pilot (Layer 2) = posterior 0.5338 with the step shown; DAL honestly unchanged (no firing signals; PHI DL healthy - Carter Active). Injury digest defect found and fixed (ESPN nests team on athlete in this feed version). Pushed: 5d9825ffd + fusion commit. Standing rule holds: a withhold is a mint action, the ranked board is the output.
